issue.body:
## Problem

Browser/native login, account reauthentication and MCP approval lack a shared credential-verification boundary for safe authentication preparation. This is a bounded child of #421, not the complete Firebase migration.

## Requirements and acceptance

- Centralize local password verification while preserving caller-owned lookup, validation, access checks and session issuance across browser/native login, account changes and MCP approval.
- Preserve bcrypt and unknown-account dummy comparison behavior, existing byte handling, account identity, ownership, session/Wear/offline contracts and database schema.
- Keep Firebase disabled; validate synthetic provider mapping, invalid credentials, forged claims, transport failures and timeouts without live provider access.
- Maintain the affected route/provider regression tests and concise migration-preparation documentation; cover the full 12-file published PR431 scope.
- No live account reads/imports, Firebase activation/provisioning, credential changes, deployment or release. Full #421 remains open and unfinished.

## Implementation plan

Use the existing shared helper and provider boundary, integrate existing callers, and preserve maintained contract tests. This checkpoint targets master; PR423 preparation is already merged. Existing implementation evidence stays in PR431; independent QA must reassess final issue/body/linkage before readiness.

## Implementing Codex task

Verified existing task ID: `01a10cfe-a79f-7198-9e8f-2b4dc6703031`. Shareable link unavailable through current tools.

## Implementing PR

[PR431](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/pull/431). This PR implements only this checkpoint; #421 remains the nonclosing parent outcome.
